newsitem.title: USA: Department 56 files for share distribution.
newsitem.headline: Department 56 files for share distribution.

text.p: Department 56 Inc said Wednesday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission that will enable Forstmann Little & Co to distribute about 2.2 million shares of its stock to Forstmann Little investors.
The shares represent about 10.6 percent of the company's outstanding common stock.
Forstmann Little reduced its Department 56 position through an initial public offering in June 1993 and cut its stake further through secondary offerings in the spring of 1994 and 1995.

"This distribution reflects our ongoing confidence in the management team, and our belief that after four years, our limited partners should now be in a position to make their own investment decisions concerning their holdings in Department 56," said senior partner Theodore Forstmann.
Department 56 is a designer, importer and distributor of collectibles and other specialty giftware products.
Forstmann Little is a private investment firm.
